command: SDK_ACTIVE=<locally assembled managed SDK active symlink> M4_NATIVE_EVIDENCE=<evidence directory> cargo test --offline --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -p fframes-studio --test x11_shell the_native_shell_freezes_scene_and_range_scope_and_shows_before_and_after_evidence -- --ignored --nocapture
summary: The real fframes-studio shell on an owned Xvfb, driven with xdotool and observed through redacted telemetry, selected a scene and a half-open frame range; the scene task held a validated candidate for ManualReview with revision-matched before/after evidence, while the range task exercised the default AutoApply path. AutoApply now decodes the bounded task-owned PNG previews before publishing the after-evidence message that triggers promotion; the native test verifies the accepted terminal snapshot is already Released and has all before/after images loaded. Both thumbnails cover the same selected frames under distinct base/candidate revisions, and the terminal panel distinguishes Last task scope from the next Submit scope. Each prompt included one bounded PNG image block per listed app-owned artifact only after the scripted ACP peer negotiated image support; tests verified decoded bytes stayed within the 4 MiB prompt budget and image bytes never appeared in prompt text. ManualReview still shows Apply/Discard controls; the follow-up composer fits within 1280x800. A queued scope was marked stale after the preview identity changed and refused without starting a second writer; the test waits for the refusal panel to settle before capturing it. Refreshed screenshots were inspected. The separate M3 native apply/undo Xvfb regression also passed. The peer remains a fixture, not provider qualification.
